exposure: Rohingya women with different sources of FP knowledge
Rohingya women with different number of children
outcome: Knowledge, attitude, and practice (KAP) of family planning (FP)
cohort: 400 Rohingya women living in refugee camps in Bangladesh
finding: This study reveals a low level of family planning knowledge, attitude, and practice among Rohingya refugee women in Bangladesh, largely due to limited education, cultural beliefs, and restricted access to healthcare.
